# Monk Technologies - AI Training Institute

> Hands-on AI training institute in Bengaluru, India offering MLOps, GenAI, and Python courses

## About

Monk Technologies is a training-first AI academy based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. We prepare learners to build production AI systems, work with modern GenAI tools, and deploy ML models with confidence.

## Courses

We offer hands-on courses and bootcamps in:

- **MLOps Fundamentals**: Learn the MLOps lifecycle, experiment tracking with MLflow, containerization with Docker, and model deployment with BentoML. Target audience: students with no prior AI/ML experience. Part of the 2-month program.
  URL: https://monk-technologies.com/courses/mlops-fundamentals

- **MLOps & GenAI**: Comprehensive 2-month bootcamp covering MLOps practices, generative AI applications, RAG systems, LangChain, CI/CD for ML models, and production deployment.
  URL: https://monk-technologies.com/courses/mlops-genai

- **Generative AI & Prompt Engineering**: Master prompt engineering techniques (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, LangChain framework, and agentic AI systems. Target audience: students with no prior AI/ML experience. Part of the 2-month program.
  URL: https://monk-technologies.com/courses/generative-ai-prompt-engineering

- **AI Agent Engineering**: Build autonomous AI agents, implement agentic workflows, and create production-ready agent systems.
  URL: https://monk-technologies.com/courses/ai-agent-engineering

- **Python Fundamentals**: Optional beginner-level Python course for learners preparing for MLOps and GenAI courses.
  URL: https://monk-technologies.com/courses/python-fundamentals

## Key Information

- **Location**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), India
- **Format**: Hands-on, project-driven, instructor-led sessions
- **Community**: Active WhatsApp community for learners, alumni, and mentors
- **Focus**: Portfolio-grade projects, production-ready skills, career preparation
- **Approach**: Training-first education with emphasis on building real systems

## Target Audience

Our courses are designed for:
- Students new to AI/ML looking to enter the field
- Professionals seeking hands-on MLOps and GenAI skills
- Learners who want to build production-ready AI systems
- Anyone interested in AI training bootcamps in India

## Teaching Philosophy

We train learners to be critical thinkers who can build, critique, and lead in AI—not just use existing tools. Our project-driven curriculum emphasizes real-world applications, portfolio-grade work, and community support.
